options.concept: A confident Dan fist-bumps his new robot coach while his surprised former trainer leaves through a gym doorway.
options.image_prompt_9x16: Create a photorealistic vertical advertising thumbnail, 9:16, 1080x1920. Use the attached real photographs as Dan Rose's likeness references: the same recognizable man around 40, lean and shredded, not bulky, same size as the reference. He wears black gym shorts, shirtless, with his face clearly visible and a confident, friendly smile. Stage the action in the upper two-thirds: Dan is the dominant foreground subject, exchanging a clear fist bump with a secondary graphite robot coach beside him. The robot has restrained chartreuse illuminated details, natural mechanical proportions and no branding. In the distant upper-left doorway, one smaller adult human trainer in a plain tan polo looks surprised while walking away, carrying a single blank rolled workout sheet. Keep this background figure subordinate and readable. Use a saturated emerald gym environment, dramatic warm light on Dan, deep shadows and crisp separation. Keep Dan's face large enough to recognize at phone size. The bottom third transitions naturally into a smooth, dark evergreen field, with no bodies, equipment or bright highlights crossing it. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the empty headline area at x=0.07–0.93, y=0.69–0.95.

options.concept: A ridiculously confident orange robot gym coach gives two enormous thumbs up, with the headline filling its oversized black shirt.
options.image_prompt_9x16: Create a bold, funny, highly polished character image for a vertical advertising thumbnail, 9:16, 1080x1920. One monumental matte-orange robot gym coach fills the frame, facing the camera with an unmistakably cheerful, overconfident expression, expressive mechanical eyebrows and a broad friendly mechanical smile. It wears a comically tiny plain terracotta athletic sweatband and an oversized plain black gym polo with no badge. Its head occupies the upper quarter. Its two oversized robotic hands give enthusiastic thumbs up near the lower outside corners, framing rather than covering the torso. Use strong foreshortening, believable mechanical joints and rounded industrial design. The central black polo chest must be broad, smooth, evenly dark and completely unobstructed, serving as the headline field. Keep the pose readable as one simple silhouette. Use a saturated burnt-orange background, warm cream rim lighting and rich black contrast, with no gym clutter, halo or neon effects. No other people or objects. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the empty headline area on the black chest at x=0.08–0.92, y=0.34–0.65.
options.image_prompt_16x9: Create a bold, funny, highly polished character image for a landscape advertising thumbnail, 16:9, 1920x1080. Use a saturated burnt-orange background, warm cream rim lighting and rich black contrast, with no gym clutter, halo or neon effects. No other people or objects. options.concept: An enormous robotic hand tears a trainer's blank paper workout plan in half in a dramatic close-up.
options.image_prompt_9x16: Create a striking photorealistic action image for a vertical advertising thumbnail, 9:16, 1080x1920. Show an extreme close-up of two articulated gunmetal robotic hands tearing one completely blank paper workout sheet into two pieces. The action occupies the lower half: the hands pull apart horizontally, exposing a bold jagged tear and a few large airborne paper fragments. The paper must be visibly blank on both sides, with no marks, grids or symbols. Include only a small portion of a plain black clipboard beneath the paper, enough to suggest a discarded trainer's rigid plan without adding clutter. The robot's face and body are outside the frame. Use a saturated scarlet background, hard directional light, silver metal highlights and a dramatic low camera angle. Freeze the main hands and torn edges sharply; allow slight motion blur only on peripheral paper fragments. Keep the top half a smooth scarlet field with no fragments, arms or highlights intruding. The image should feel explosive and decisive, with one clear action readable at phone size. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the empty headline area at x=0.08–0.92, y=0.08–0.40.
